adminAutomation.rulesIntro: Each store can enable its own rule set. During a run, the system evaluates every pending pickup request for enabled stores and records the result in the automation decisions table below.
adminAutomation.rulesRunTitle: What gets checked during a run
adminAutomation.rulesRunEnabledStores: Only stores with automation enabled are processed.
adminAutomation.rulesRunPendingOnly: Only pickup requests that are still waiting for confirmation are evaluated. Already confirmed requests are skipped.
adminAutomation.rulesRunOrder: Requests are checked store by store, and the decision reasons are saved for every evaluated request.
adminAutomation.rulesRunDryRunOverride: A per-store test run applies only to that store; the app-wide test-run setting still forces test runs everywhere.
adminAutomation.rulesRunDryRun: A test run uses the same logic but does not confirm or decline anything on Foodsharing. It only shows what would happen.
adminAutomation.rulesGracePeriodTitle: Automatic approval two calendar days before pickup
adminAutomation.rulesGracePeriodBody: From midnight in Zurich on the calendar day two days before a pickup, the normal automation rules are skipped and the request is allowed automatically. Enabled public-holiday rules and manually reviewed dates still apply.
adminAutomation.rulesGapSameStore: The gap rule checks whether the same person already has another pickup in the same store.
adminAutomation.rulesGapCalendarDays: The gap is calculated in calendar days in the Zurich timezone, excluding the pickup days themselves.
adminAutomation.rulesGapExample: Example: if the minimum gap is 2, a pickup on Monday and another on Wednesday is still too close because only Tuesday lies between them.
adminAutomation.rulesExperienceOwnHistor: A person counts as experienced in a store if Foodsharing membership data shows at least one previous pickup there.
adminAutomation.rulesExperienceCoPickup: If the person has no experience, the request can still pass when another person on the same pickup is experienced in that store.
adminAutomation.rulesCleaningExemption: If a Foodsharing ID has a cleaning exemption, the cleaning rule is skipped for that person.
adminAutomation.rulesCleaningHistory: Otherwise the system checks the cleaning store configured for the current district within the configured lookback period.
adminAutomation.rulesCleaningFuture: The rule also passes if the person already has a future cleaning pickup planned.
adminAutomation.rulesCleaningOverride: If neither of those is true, the request is normally declined. It is only allowed as an override when fewer than four future cleaning slots are still empty.

adminAutomation.linkedStoreHint: Every pickup here needs its own pickup in one of the linked stores. You can choose several stores; one of them is enough per pickup, and the pickups in all chosen stores together must cover the pickups here (3 pickups here: e.g. 1 in B and 2 in C). A pickup in a linked store only counts for one pickup here. With both directions, every pickup in one of the chosen stores also needs a pickup here. From the sign-up time (signUpDate) the person has the configured time to book the second slot. After that they are removed from the slot and receive the message below. Like all rules, this one no longer applies from two calendar days before the pickup. If the linked slot is not confirmed yet, this slot stays pending until both can be confirmed. With both directions, “before” and “after” are swapped for the reverse direction.

import.title: Import past EinAbs
import.intro: Upload the EinAb protocol as an Excel file (.xlsx) or a CSV (columns: ID, Datum, No., Betrieb, Kategorie, EinAb giver, FT visit, Feedback). From the Excel file, the EinAb giver is matched by their Foodsharing ID in the "EinAb-Geberinnen" sheet. You see a preview first and nothing is imported until you confirm. The file is not stored.
import.refreshHint: Afterwards the user data is refreshed from Foodsharing slowly in the background (about one user every 2 seconds). You do not have to wait.
import.safeToRepeat: It is safe to run the import again: EinAbs that already exist (user, date, store) are skipped.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: Here you can delete your account in the Foodsharing EinAB Tool (website and app "EinAb"), also without signing in. Enter your Foodsharing ID. We send you a message on foodsharing.network with a link to confirm the deletion.
deleteAccount.whatHappens: We delete your name, Foodsharing ID, phone number, the EinAb guides' notes about you, notification subscriptions, sign-in sessions and push phones. Future bookings are cancelled. Past EinAbs stay anonymous (without a name) for the district's statistics. Your account on foodsharing.network is not affected.
deleteAccount.signedInHint: Faster when signed in: Profile → Delete account.
deleteAccount.sent: If there is an account for this Foodsharing ID, we sent you a message on foodsharing.network. Open the link in it within 24 hours.

deleteAccount.done: Your account was deleted. If you sign in again later, you start with an empty account.

error.ACCOUNT_DELETION_FOODSHARING_CONNE: Your account is connected to foodsharing for automations. Disconnect it first, then you can delete your account.
error.ACCOUNT_DELETION_LINK_INVALID: This deletion link is invalid, expired or was already used. Request a new one.

profile.deleteAccountIntro: What happens when you delete your account:

profile.deleteAccountKept: Past EinAbs stay without your name for the statistics.
profile.deleteAccountAgain: You can sign in again at any time and then start with an empty account. Your foodsharing account is not affected.
